uniques.name: Hearthbrand
uniques.flavor: Warmed each dawn in the public kiln until the steel remembered fire.

uniques.name: Last Vigil
uniques.flavor: The watch-cap of the final shift on the Spire stair.

uniques.name: Kilnwalker
uniques.flavor: Soot baked into the seams. The floor never quite burns.

uniques.name: Spire Widow
uniques.flavor: Hung for years on a broken beam, and still keeping watch.

uniques.name: Senn's Measure
uniques.flavor: Senn says it counts fair. Count it yourself.

uniques.name: Glass Oath
uniques.flavor: A promise cut thin enough to see through.

uniques.name: Kiln Tyrant's Collar
uniques.flavor: The collar cracked when the tyrant did. The heat stayed.

uniques.name: Briar Tooth
uniques.flavor: Snapped from a snare that had already caught something. The sap never dried.

uniques.name: Moth Lamp
uniques.flavor: A hood scorched from the inside, as if a small fire had lived there and left.

uniques.name: Salt March
uniques.flavor: The salt ate the stitching and then, politely, held the boot together anyway.

uniques.name: Widow Grip
uniques.flavor: Wrapped for a watch that ended at dawn. The grip stayed warm.

uniques.name: Kiln Oath
uniques.flavor: Sworn on the public kiln. The oath cracked. The maul did not.

uniques.name: Reed String
uniques.flavor: Strung with a reed that still remembers the mere. It hums when the air is wet.

uniques.name: Hush Staff
uniques.flavor: The galleries asked for quiet. The staff agreed, and then it did not.

uniques.name: Spire Vow
uniques.flavor: A watch-blade left point-down in a cracked step, still keeping the hour.

uniques.name: Heart Nail
uniques.flavor: Used to pin a kiln door that would not stay shut. The door lost.

uniques.name: Last Watch Plate
uniques.flavor: The last shift wore this until the stairs gave. The plate came back. They did not.

uniques.name: Wicker Prayer
uniques.flavor: A prayer woven in, then smoked over the kiln until the words went black.

uniques.name: Kiln Door
uniques.flavor: A slice of the kiln door, still convinced it is a door.

uniques.name: Garnet Loop
uniques.flavor: Cut from a garnet that sweated in the heat. It still feels a little alive.

uniques.name: Mere Pearl
uniques.flavor: Fished out of still water. It looks at you the way the mere does.

uniques.name: Glass Cap
uniques.flavor: A cap glazed with salt until it rang. The ring is the warning.

uniques.name: Beetle Mail
uniques.flavor: Plates from a press beetle that would not stop pushing. The mail still leans.

uniques.name: Silt Shroud
uniques.flavor: Morra wore the water. What dried on this coat is not quite mud.

uniques.name: Sallow's Crown
uniques.flavor: Grown, not forged. It fits whoever cut the first tree, and it is still angry.

uniques.name: Root Belt
uniques.flavor: A root that decided to be a belt. It tightens when you are afraid.

uniques.name: Orchard Knife
uniques.flavor: Used on fruit that should not have been red. The edge still smells sweet and wrong.

uniques.name: Branded Saber
uniques.flavor: The brand does not wash off. Ash Strike remembers it.

uniques.name: Caller's Cord
uniques.flavor: Tied while the glass was still wet. The bolt comes cheaper.

uniques.name: Row Walkers
uniques.flavor: The rows do not catch these. The snares do the catching.

uniques.name: Unbanked Loop
uniques.flavor: One rank in everything you kept. The kiln does not get a vote.

uniques.name: Short Promise
uniques.flavor: A cut that pays you back. Do not stand still to collect.

uniques.name: Kept Bell
uniques.flavor: Wrapped, then unwrapped. The note is yours now.

uniques.name: Sear Cuff
uniques.flavor: The step lands hot. The cuff is why.

uniques.name: Vigil Hood
uniques.flavor: Worn for a watch that did not end. The ring of it still holds.

uniques.name: Spark Band
uniques.flavor: A ring that throws the first spark so you do not have to.

uniques.name: Brine Board
uniques.flavor: A board from a stilt that learned to keep the cold off.

uniques.name: Second Thread
uniques.flavor: One more voice in the glass. The coat keeps the seam shut.

uniques.name: Jaw Cord
uniques.flavor: Tied so the snares close when you say so, not when they feel like it.

uniques.name: Needle Wrap
uniques.flavor: The point was already in the glove. You just give it a direction.

uniques.name: Crouch Tread
uniques.flavor: The rows hear the other boots. These they argue about.

uniques.name: Banked Coal
uniques.flavor: One coal kept back from the kiln. It spends itself once, and means it.

uniques.name: Pale Note
uniques.flavor: A note cut into the stair and then pulled back out. It still rings.

uniques.name: Mawglass
uniques.flavor: The ring sweats when the floor opens.

uniques.name: Stillbell
uniques.flavor: A bell that was wrapped before it could finish the note.

uniques.name: Shadechord
uniques.flavor: Worn by something that stepped out of its own shadow.

uniques.name: Kilntooth
uniques.flavor: A tooth of the kiln. It stays sharp because the fire never left it.

setItems.name: Sentinel Hood
setItems.flavor: The hood of the first watch. Soot in every seam, and a smell of wet ash.

setItems.name: Sentinel Coat
setItems.flavor: Issued when the march still thought it would come home.

setItems.name: Sentinel Girdle
setItems.flavor: Senn knotted it. He counts nails twice. He counts people once.

setItems.name: Saltglass Edge
setItems.flavor: An edge that spent a winter in the salt. It cuts cleaner when the air is cold.

setItems.name: Saltglass Band
setItems.flavor: A ring of fused salt and glass. It clicks against the saber like a second promise.

setItems.name: Briar Hood
setItems.flavor: A hood stitched with thorn-thread. It snags on everything, including luck.

setItems.name: Briar Wrap
setItems.flavor: Worn by stalkers who preferred the ground to do their arguing.

setItems.name: Briar Fang
setItems.flavor: The short tooth of the set. It prefers to be left behind in something living.

setItems.name: Bell Loop
setItems.flavor: A ring that wants to ring. The wrapping is the only reason it does not.

setItems.name: Bell Cord
setItems.flavor: Cut from a wrapped bell-rope. It stays quiet if you do.

setItems.name: March Boots
setItems.flavor: Issued for the first walk out of Hearthveil. The soles are already thin.

setItems.name: March Wraps
setItems.flavor: Cloth wraps for hands that were going to hold a hot hilt.

setItems.name: Lamp Hood
setItems.flavor: A hood worn so the moths would not land on your face.

setItems.name: Lamp Cord
setItems.flavor: Tied like a wick. It smells faintly of fruit you should not eat.

setItems.name: Pale Hood
setItems.flavor: The color of the stair. It does not show ash until you are home.

setItems.name: Pale Mail
setItems.flavor: Mail for a watch that was supposed to end at the tombs.

setItems.name: Oath Ring
setItems.flavor: A name was cut inside it. You can feel the letters and not read them.

setItems.name: Oath Cord
setItems.flavor: Worn by someone who climbed and came back down without their name.

bonuses.text: +18 cold resist, +20 mana, +1 to all skills
